thread:
Priya: sharing a first-pass PRD + rollout spec for the model pin/canary experiment. want quick review on acceptance criteria and rollback thresholds. TL;DR: staged canary, auto-rollback on clear perf/quality regressions, tenant pin TTLs, and experiment metrics matrix. :eyes:
Ben: reading now. quick q — are we doing per-tenant pins or global route pinning?
Priya: per-tenant by default, global opt-in for platform tests. reason: minimize blast radius but allow org-wide rollout later.
Sofia: agree per-tenant. add a guard for short-lived sticky pins (48h) so we don't accidentally pin forever.
Liam: can we add an automatic unpin TTL + reminder to the tenant owner? we should surface stale pins in console.
Priya: yep — TTL 48h and a reminder at 24h + console badge.
Noah: security: any data-handling changes with the variant? if model variant hits a different backend, ensure KMS keys and audit logs still flow.
Priya: no new data flows expected, but noted. will include a checklist for key rotation/audit validation before canary.
Ben: sketching acceptance criteria drafts: minimal list: 1) no p95 latency regression > 20% or >100ms absolute, 2) error rate increase <= 0.5% absolute, 3) quality eval drop <= 3 percentage points on our regression set, 4) cost delta <= +15% per 1M tokens. others?
Sofia: also track hallucination / hallucination-sensitivity with our secret prompt set — threshold: drop in pass-rate <= 2.5% absolute triggers rollback.
Ava: ops: add SLO watch windows: evaluate each phase at 15m rolling and 1h aggregate. if either window trips rollback.
Priya: good. here's the experiment plan (cfg snippet):
```yaml
experiment: canary-variant-2026-03
phases:
  - pct: 1
    duration: 30m
  - pct: 5
    duration: 1h
  - pct: 20
    duration: 4h
metrics:
  latency.p95: baseline_p95
  errors.rate: baseline_error_rate
  quality.eval_score: baseline_eval
rollback_rules:
  latency_p95_delta_pct: 20
  latency_p95_delta_ms: 100
  error_rate_abs_pct: 0.5
  quality_drop_abs: 0.03
  hallucination_drop_abs: 0.025
```
Ben: one small ask — we need a deterministic evaluation runner tied to the canary traffic. split sample: 5% of canary traffic gets echo-eval prompt set so we can collect ground truth.
Sofia: agree. will add eval sampling and an offline job to re-run failed cases.
Liam: console changes: show per-tenant pin + expiry, current phase, active metric diffs, and a single-click rollback. also surface suggested rollback reason.
Priya: rollout guard rails: manual approval needed to move above 20% for paid-tier orgs; for internal test orgs we can auto-advance.
Noah: add a compliance check: if any tenant is PCI/PHI flagged, disallow auto-advance; require security signoff.
Ava: oncall playbook snippet: if auto-rollback fires, deploy-bot should trigger rollback, create incident stub with metrics snapshot and notify #eng-oncall + tenant owner.
deploy-bot: deployed canary phase 1 -> 1% at 2026-03-15T14:02:10Z :rocket:
Ben: dev note — ensure runtime can route fallback to previous pinned model variant without requeueing requests. need a fast switch in router.
Priya: documented fallback — immediate fallback to last known-good model variant within the same pool, otherwise use global fallback model.
Sofia: edge case: cold-KV-cache behavior on new variant causing transient latency — we should ignore transient blips in first 5m of a phase, focus on steady-state. define stabilization window = first 5m of phase.
Ava: ops: agreed. evaluate metrics after stabilization window. also cap total ramp time so a bad canary doesn't linger.
Priya: decision log (proposed): per-tenant pin default, pin TTL 48h with 24h reminder, staged ramp 1/5/20, stabilization window 5m, rollback thresholds as above, manual approval >20% for paid/PCI tenants.
Liam: UX followups: (1) enable one-click abort + reason, (2) surface suggested rollback trigger, (3) history view for pins/rollouts.
Noah: security checklist: KMS verification, audit log proof, compliance flag check. will share final checklist by EOD.
Sofia: I'll add a small experiment to test quantized variant behaviour (memory/KV differences) under production-like load.
Ben: if everyone is okay i'll mark this PRD ready for 'spec review' and schedule a short sync tomorrow. :+1:
Priya: thanks all — please add one-line reactions if you agree or leave comments inline. planning to freeze API and rollout config by EOD and open RFC for review. :shipit:
